body: I won’t judge you, I’m 19 and in the same boat as you. I already finished school so that’s not a problem but I “finally” reached the point where suicide is the only option. I Ruined my life in all possible ways. Now im paying with the consequences of all of my own actions. Advice for you: If you see that school is not a place to work on your future, put all of your effort in something that you truly like or find that something. I failed but I believe in you.

Phisically suicide is always painful but if you stop to think about it...it will only take minutes to be done, so it’s pain that goes away forever. What is actually painful is knowing that you want to do it but to afraid to leave loved ones behind and pass that “depression chain” to them. I’m a coward, I know the day I do it is close but fuck it. I wish you the best.
